_comment: GENERATED by scripts/dune-base-setup.mjs — maps each file under dune/base-chain/ to its Dune query id. /api/cron/dune-refresh imports dependentQueryIds to know what to re-run daily. That list is only the queries WITH A PANEL on the dashboard: 13_by_service, 14_by_contract and 15_by_rail are deployed but off the dashboard (see OFF_DASHBOARD in the script), so running them would spend credits updating nothing. Safe to hand-edit only when the queries were created manually on dune.com (free-plan fallback).
